## Review

Independent review (2026-11-23), no code changed. 0 High, 5 Medium, 5 Low. Checked and sound: game numbers cannot be given twice (publishing deletes the draft before the max read, so two publications wait in turn; binned games count in the max; the unique index is still there behind it); the status change happens inside the publication's transaction; the new-date form carries the draft's version (A-8 holds).

- Medium, new-date-form.tsx:137 with summarize-publish.ts:19: a "new date" equal to the game's own slot is saved (wasSlot empty) and the draft calls it scheduled, but sameSlot sees no move, so publishing does nothing (the box says "nothing to publish") and the waiting list keeps saying "New date in the schedule draft… counts once published". The game is stuck until the draft is thrown away. Fix: count a postponed-to-scheduled change as moved in summarizePublish, or refuse the game's own slot in the form.
- Medium, apply-change.ts:131: swap-games moves a postponed game to the other game's slot but leaves it postponed, so publishing changes its date and it still waits, unlike move-game. Fix: make a postponed game scheduled in a swap too, or refuse the swap, with a test.
- Medium, call-off-texts.ts:86: "postpone it and give it a new date now" is offered to anyone who may postpone (games.results), but the form is drawn only for people with schedule.edit for that season (new-date-form.tsx:63). A results keeper lands on a list item with no form. Fix: offer the second answer only when the person may edit that season's schedule.
- Medium, publish-summary.ts:18 and 43: the moved line names only the day and time, so a court, venue or round change reads "from Sat at 6:00 PM to Sat at 6:00 PM". Fix: add the place (and the round when it changes) to the line when the time is the same; add a test for a court-only move.
- Medium, insert-published-games.ts:73: the numbering (after the season's highest, binned games counted, date order, empty past 100000) has no database test, only the stand-in store and core's order. Fix: add a stores test that publishes two added games next to a binned game with a higher number and checks the numbers.
- Low, schedule-page.tsx:1517: "Publish this schedule" can be tapped twice. Nothing is published twice (the draft is claimed), but the second answer the person sees is a refusal ("changed since read") after a publish that worked. Fix: disable the button once it is sent, or treat a draft already published by this person as done.
- Low, staff-pages.css:53: the sticky bar may cover a game the summary or a blocker link jumps to (#game-…), and keyboard focus moving up the grid. staff.css's scroll-padding is one tap high, and the bar wraps to two or three lines at 390 px. Not checked on a picture. Fix: set the padding from the bar's height and test focus at phone width.
- Low, the waiting list: once a new date is drafted there is no way back from there, and "Put it back on its date" while a date is drafted reschedules the game at once and the draft still moves it later. Fix: offer "Take back the new date" (a move back in the draft) beside the drafted line.
- Low, schedule-publish-commands.test.ts:464: the title promises "leaves a cancelled one called off" but the body tests only the postponed game. Fix: add the cancelled game to the test.
- Low, tests: reschedule-test.mjs:95 finds the publish button by its English name across the whole page (use a data mark in the publish box), and publish-preview-test.mjs:141 checks only that some "game n" is shown, not that it is the next number in date order.
